title: Transformer Native 3D BPT Pilot
description: Small BPT integration dataset. Duck and Food Lime training, Avocado validation, Box control. Four Y quarter-turns per asset. Quantization removes 2.75%, 1.86%, 0.15%, and 0% of source faces, respectively. Contains derived quantized meshes, sampled conditioning points and token streams. Duck is under SCEA Shared Source License 1.0, Box CC-BY-4.0, Avocado and Food Lime CC0. Preserved notices and source manifests are included. Not a representative corpus.
